d:
Pradhanmantri narendr modi ne bihar men NDA sarkar ke ek sal ke karyakal men hue vikas karyon ka jikr kiya.
Unhonne bihar men 2 lakh karor se adhik ke nivesh samjhauton, gaya men ₹6,000 karor ki stil pariyojna aur 200 se jyada nae digri kolej shuru hone ki bat kahi.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
